text:
The plate is a square side plate, roughly 20-22 cm across (it spans about 345 px). The carrots pile covers roughly 200 px, which is about 12 cm, and the pieces are small slices.

I count about 12-15 carrot pieces, plus a few loose ones. Each piece is roughly 5-8 g, and the larger ones may be closer to 10 g. That gives about 100-130 g in total.

Cooked glazed carrots run about 40-50 kcal per 100 g. At roughly 110 g, that comes to about 50 kcal, or about 70 kcal if there is some butter or glaze.
